# Criaphore

## Introduction

Criaphore is SaaS company creating applications in service of people powered by AI

## Applications

[Orbora](https://criaphore.com/orbora/): Generative audio wellness agentic app developed by Criaphore
[Diagnosly](https://criaphore.com/diagnosly/): Archived AI health companion app by Criaphore, with a guided symptom check-up, AI chat, document summaries and a private health profile stored encrypted on the phone
